title: Mycorrhizal Intelligence Ecosystem
definition: A philosophical and technical framework for content-addressed, scientifically-validated knowledge storage and sharing.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of a garden where all the plants (knowledge) grow and communicate with each other. This garden never forgets where each plant came from or what makes it special.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Mycorrhizal Intelligence Ecosystem (CADMIES) is a system that stores and shares scientific and philosophical concepts as interconnected, content-addressed blocks (IPLD). Each concept has a unique and permanent CID (Content IDentifier), ensuring that the same content always has the same identifier.
difficulty_levels.expert: CADMIES' mycorrhizal intelligence ecosystem is a novel system that applies the principles of mycorrhizal networks to create a decentralized, verifiable, and scientifically-validated knowledge storage and sharing system. It draws from the fields of information science, philosophy, and biology, challenging traditional methods of knowledge storage and retrieval.

extra_fields.insight: The mycorrhizal intelligence ecosystem allows for the creation of a decentralized, verifiable, and scientifically-validated knowledge storage and sharing system that challenges traditional methods and draws from multiple disciplines.
